## Using R and Python Together

This post demonstrates how R and Python can work together in the same Quarto document. First, I create an object in R and then use that object in Python.

```{r}
library(reticulate)

life_expectancy <- c(68.8, 73.4, 75.2, 70.1, 77.5)

life_expectancy
```

## Passing Data from R to Python

The R object `life_expectancy` is passed to Python using `r.life_expectancy`.

```{python}
import numpy as np

life_exp_python = np.array(r.life_expectancy)

mean_life_expectancy = life_exp_python.mean()

mean_life_expectancy
```
## Passing the Result Back to R

The mean calculated in Python can be accessed from R using `py$mean_life_expectancy`.

```{r}
mean_from_python <- py$mean_life_expectancy

mean_from_python
```
